findings.description: [defect] The fieldset legends ("Alert Routing" and "CLI Defaults") straddle the top card border without a uniform backing, leaving a faint two-tone background transition behind the text where the light-gray page background meets the white card fill.

[defect] The select controls ("Escalation Channel" and "Default Output Format") render slightly taller than the adjacent text inputs ("Primary Incident Email" and "Default Control Plane Region"), introducing a subtle height inconsistency between sibling form inputs.

[suggestion] On desktop, the right-aligned native checkboxes in "Alert Routing" sit across a wide horizontal gap from their left-aligned labels; placing checkboxes to the left of their labels or using toggle switches would make the label-to-control pairing easier to scan.

[suggestion] On the mobile viewport, the label "Page on SLO error-budget burn (> 5%/hr)" breaks between ">" and "5%/hr)"; keeping "(> 5%/hr)" together with a non-breaking space would improve line-wrap readability.

verdict.summary: Clean, well-structured single-column preferences form across both desktop and mobile viewports with clear typography, consistent left/right alignment, and no critical or major visual defects. Only minor styling polish items and optional readability suggestions were observed.
